claims.text: The architecture is four repositories in one flow. ap_pipeline, ap_forecast and ap_aging run on Python 3.9, and ap_portal runs on Node.js 22 CommonJS and renders HTML from JSON. JSON between services carries amounts as strings with two decimals and dates as ISO strings. Keep every existing signature; add new functions.
build_explanation_request(vendor, predicted_days, config=None) gains risk=None as its last parameter, so existing calls are unchanged. When risk is given, the prompt ends with ' Risk level: <risk>.'.
vendor_risk returns 'high' when predict_delay_days(history) > 30, 'medium' when it is > 10, and otherwise 'low'. It uses no LLM.
overdue_with_risk includes only unpaid invoices that are more than 30 days past due, counted in calendar days. An invoice exactly 30 days past due is excluded, and paid invoices are excluded.

The proposed JSON contract CT-1 has the fields id (string), vendor (string), days (integer, proposed), amount (two-decimal string) and risk (high/medium/low/unknown). Example row: SYN-INV-004, Synthetic Vendor A, 75, "1250.00", high.

renderOverdueRisk renders <table class="overdue-risk"> with one risk-<risk> row per item under the columns Invoice, Vendor, Days overdue and Amount, and returns an empty string when there are no rows. It outputs the amount string unchanged, without converting it to a binary float.

The Invoice data model is id (str), vendor (str), due_date (date), amount (Decimal, 2 dp), paid (bool), paid_date (date or None). Feed v3 adds an optional paid_date column, and the schedule stays daily 02:00 Asia/Kolkata.
Lanes: ap_pipeline goes to Data Engineering, ap_forecast to Data Science, ap_aging to Backend and ap_portal to Frontend; end-to-end tests go to the Testing Agent.
Security scope: no finance posting, authentication, tenancy or payment execution; tier T2; the risk label is advisory only.
The GitHub connector is the only connector approved for this step.
Decisions D-2026-031 (calendar days), D-2026-044 (Decimal, never float) and D-2026-050 (paid invoices excluded), and lessons L-007 and L-011, are applied with no conflict.
